title: BOEM — Comparison of Environmental Effects from Different Offshore Wind Turbine Foundations (foundation schematics)
description: Illustrated comparison of offshore wind foundation concepts: monopile, jacket, tripod, tri-pile, jack-up, suction bucket, gravity and floating foundations, plus scour/wake illustration. | Figures: Figure 1 — Offshore wind foundation types; Figure 2 — Monopile foundation; Figure 3 — Jacket foundation; Figure 4 — Tripod foundation; Figure 5 — Tri-pile foundation; Figure 6 — Jack-up foundation
